tools.description: To check when a Notion API, SDK or Notion MCP change shipped, or what changed since a date.
To read a Notion announcement or leadership post with proof of who wrote it and when (for example the post introducing Notion's CTO), or any engineering or product post.

To read Notion API reference pages (endpoints, objects, errors, limits), developer guides, Notion MCP, CLI and Workers docs, or the API changelog page. Call without `section` (with a small `max_chars`) to see the outline, then fetch the section you need.
To answer what Notion costs, compare plans, or check plan limits (file uploads, page history, guests, AI features, admin and security controls) without clicking the monthly/annual toggle.
